channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula pede cassação de Flávio por ligação de verba de Dark Horse ao PCC
item.description: Lula's campaign requested the cancellation of Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket at the TSE over suspected funds from the Dark Horse film linked to the PCC. The action also questions possible irregularities in contracts involving companies connected to former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Mark Ruffalo, Guillermo del Toro e artistas internacionais apoiam Lula em vídeo idealizado por Kleber Mendonça
item.description: International artists including Mark Ruffalo, Tilda Swinton, and Guillermo del Toro endorse Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a video produced by Brazilian filmmaker Kleber Mendonça Filho. The content encourages voting for Lula in the 2026 Brazilian elections, featuring a creative campaign centered on the symbolism of the letter 'L'.

item.title: Mulheres, salário e preços: as anotações de Flávio para o debate
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) traveled to Rio de Janeiro with handwritten notes on women, salaries, and prices ahead of the TV Globo presidential debate. He met with Tarcísio de Freitas to discuss strategies before facing Lula in the runoff. The debate is scheduled for 9:20 PM after the National Journal.

item.title: As nove pesquisas sobre Flávio x Lula na véspera do segundo turno da eleição
item.description: Nine polls on the Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro race are released the day before the 2026 runoff, covering 41,845 respondents nationally with margins of error between one and three points. Institutes including Datafolha, Quaest and AtlasIntel lead the surveys using various methods from in-person to phone interviews.

item.title: Exército do Lula chega a 10 milhões de seguidores no WhatsApp
item.description: The Lula Army channel, managed by federal deputy André Janones, reached 10 million WhatsApp followers, mobilizing supporters for digital activities and content sharing during the final stretch of the 2026 elections.

item.title: João Amoêdo, um dos fundadores do Novo, declara voto em Lula
item.description: João Amoêdo, a founder of the Novo party, endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for the 2026 runoff, opposing Flávio Bolsonaro. In a social media post, he argued that a potential Lula administration, despite his criticisms, poses less risk than a Bolsonaro-led government, citing concerns over Flávio's lack of experience and allegations such as the 'rachadinha' scandal.

item.title: Pastor primo de André Mendonça doa para campanha de Lula
item.description: Pastor Luís Alberto de Mendonça Sabanay, cousin of Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, donated R$20,000 to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) reelection campaign. The donation was recorded by the Electoral Justice on October 10th, following the first round of elections. The pastor serves as a national director of the PT in Santa Catarina and often criticizes the use of faith by religious authorities.

item.title: X e Meta têm 24h para esclarecer ao TSE suposto favorecimento a perfis pró-Flávio
item.description: The Chief Electoral Judge ordered X and Meta to provide clarifications to the TSE within 24 hours regarding alleged irregularities in handling pro-Flávio accounts, with a daily fine of R$ 500,000 for non-compliance.

item.title: 'Exército do Lula' alcança a marca de 10 milhões de seguidores a dois dias da eleição
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel reached 10 million followers just before the presidential runoff debate. The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) suspended orders to block the channel, with Minister Floriano de Azevedo ruling that only a judicial decision can lead to content restrictions. The movement, led by federal deputy André Janones, is used to organize PT grassroots support ahead of the election.

item.title: "Exército do Lula": canal no WhatsApp chega a 10 milhões de seguidores
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, created by federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) to support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 elections, reached 10 million followers. The channel faced suspensions and legal actions at the TSE, but minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques ordered its permanence, citing risks of instability and misinformation. The decision favored the Coligação Brasil Pronto Pra Mais, which supports Lula.

item.title: Caso Ana Clara: ato no TSE critica decisão de Mendonça contra post de Lula
item.description: Human rights organizations protested in front of TSE against Minister André Mendonça's decision to suspend the promotion of posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Ana Clara case, considered censorship. The group demands the right to publicly discuss the senator's performance during the electoral process.

item.title: Ibovespa avança 0,47% em último pregão antes do segundo turno das eleições
item.description: The Ibovespa closed up 0,47% on the last Friday before the second round of elections, driven by rising oil prices and Petrobras gains. Banks like Banco do Brasil and Bradesco also supported the index, while the dollar saw a slight decline. The market remains cautious amid a tightly contested electoral race.

item.title: Revogação de outorgas de bets antes de votação da MP no Congresso eleva insegurança jurídica no Brasil
item.description: The revocation of 85 fixed-odds betting licenses, without refund, before the vote on MP 1.394/2026 in Congress worsens legal insecurity in Brazil. Companies that invested 2.55 billion reais in licenses and 7.5 billion in equity capital now face asset losses and disruption of long-term investment plans.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Os bastidores do debate na Globo e Brasil igual ao 1º turno
item.description: The Papo Antagonista discusses the behind-the-scenes of the latest debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro before the runoff, along with polls showing a scenario unchanged from the first round.

item.title: Debate da Globo hoje: veja horário, onde assistir e regras
item.description: Globo broadcasts debate between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on Friday (23), right after National News, simulcast on open TV, GloboNews, g1 and Globoplay. The format includes four thematic blocks with different dynamics, lasting around two hours.

item.title: Co-presidente do grupo de Doria doa R$ 2 mil para campanha de Lula
item.description: Izabella Teixeira, former minister and co-president of LIDE, donated R$ 2,000 to Lula's re-election campaign, despite João Doria supporting Flávio Bolsonaro. The contribution was made via Pix in the final stretch of the runoff.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede cassação da chapa de Flávio por caso Dark Horse
item.description: Lula's campaign requests annulment of Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket over Dark Horse case suspicions, alleging use of funds for political promotion. The lawsuit questions $24 million financing for a film about Jair Bolsonaro, suggesting indirect electoral benefit. It calls for investigations, evidence sharing, and potential eight-year ineligibility.

item.title: MPT apura carta do Supermercados Zona Sul enviada a funcionários em defesa de 'voto consciente' e 'hora de mudar'
item.description: The Labor Prosecutor's Office in Rio de Janeiro has opened an investigation into a letter sent by Supermercados Zona Sul to its employees ahead of the municipal elections, advocating for conscious voting and warning about Brazil's ethical, moral and political-economic model exhaustion. The company did not comment on the case.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede cassação da candidatura de Flávio por suspeitas no caso ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Lula's campaign requested the annulment of Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy over suspicions of illegal campaign financing linked to the film 'Dark Horse'. The investigation points to a $12 billion investment in the Havengate fund managed by figures close to the Bolsonaro family. The request was sent to the Federal Court Clerk with demands for evidence sharing and investigations.

item.title: Que horas vai ser o debate na Globo hoje entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula?
item.description: TV Globo will host a debate between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on Friday (23) at 9:30 PM, during the second round of the 2026 elections. The live broadcast, moderated by César Tralli, will feature real-time analysis.

item.title: Dólar cai 0,90% e fecha em R$ 4,993; Ibovespa sobe
item.description: The Brazilian real weakened as the dollar fell 0.90% to R$4.993, while the Ibovespa rose 0.47% amid October IPCA-15 inflation data showing a slowdown. A survey released on Friday shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) ahead of the 2026 presidential runoff. The IPCA-15 accumulated 4.15% inflation in 2026, exceeding the CMN target ceiling.

item.title: Pimenta vai à Argentina e critica modelo econômico de Milei
item.description: Federal deputy Paulo Pimenta (PT-SP) visited Argentina to criticize Javier Milei's economic model, highlighting cuts to pensions and social programs. He claimed that Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign intends to adopt similar measures to Milei's 'Chainsaw Plan.' Pimenta used a video on Lula's profiles to warn about potential impacts on Brazil.

item.title: Mendonça reafirma que cabe a Lula e Flávio abrir os próprios sigilos
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça reaffirmed that it is not up to the Electoral Justice to disclose confidential data of presidents Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, but candidates may open their own files on their own initiative. The decision aims to balance transparency and protection of sensitive information.

item.title: Com previsão de tempestade, TSE acompanhará clima em todo país no dia da votação
item.description: With forecasts of heavy rains for the election runoff, the TSE has activated the National Climate Situation Room to monitor weather conditions nationwide, in collaboration with the Regional Electoral Courts and partner institutions. The room aims to identify climate risks, protect polling stations, and ensure smooth voting, especially in vulnerable areas. In the first round, severe storms affected hundreds of municipalities, including parts of São Paulo and Paraná, leading to the relocation of voting in some electoral sections.

item.title: Flávio pede cassação de Lula por suposto uso eleitoral da Rádio Nacional
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a lawsuit at the TSE requesting the annulment of Lula and Alckmin's ticket, accusing Rádio Nacional of misusing public resources to support the PT campaign. The defense identified 36 segments deemed biased, including praise for the government and criticism of the PL candidate.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: a nova pesquisa do instituto que mais acertou no 1º turno
item.description: The Veritá Institute poll, which most closely matched the first-round results, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) with 51.3% of valid votes against 48.7%, within the margin of error. The survey was conducted between October 18 and 22, with 15,554 interviews and a 1 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Eleições: Organizações acionam TSE e PGR por transporte para quilombolas e comunidades tradicionais
item.description: Organizations such as the Cerrado Network and the Unified Black Movement filed a lawsuit requesting the TSE and PGR ensure transportation for voters from quilomola and traditional communities in the second round of elections. The demand aims to guarantee access to polling stations and return to territories after voting. The action highlights the need for inclusion and electoral accessibility for historically marginalized populations.

item.title: Lula é orientado a evitar provocações de Flávio no debate da Globo
item.description: Lula met with his campaign team to prepare for the TV Globo debate, where he was advised to avoid provocations from Flávio Bolsonaro and focus on government achievements. The strategy aims to maintain a more constructive stance during the presidential debate.

item.title: Qual é o horário e como assistir ao debate da Globo entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro nas eleições 2026
item.description: The Globo presidential debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro will take place on Friday, October 23, 2026, starting at 9:20 PM, after the Jornal Nacional. The debate will air on open TV and digital platforms including G1, GN, and GloboPlay, with live coverage by JOTA from 7:00 PM. Both candidates confirmed their participation following controversies and cancellations in earlier debates during the first round.

item.title: Debate deve ser visto por 100 milhões de eleitores, projeta instituto de pesquisa
item.description: An Ipespe/Abrapel survey projects that 100 million voters may watch the debate between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) scheduled for tonight on Globo. Seven out of ten Brazilians say they will definitely watch the showdown.

item.title: Janones fará live e não irá à Globo para o debate, diz campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign states André Janones will not attend the Globo debate, choosing a live stream instead. The debate will be between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Cleitinho confirma presença no ato de Flávio Bolsonaro em BH neste sábado
item.description: Minas Gerais' elected governor Cleitinho Azevedo ( Republicans) confirmed his attendance at Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) event in Belo Horizonte this Saturday (October 24th), at Praça da Liberdade. This marks the first joint public appearance between the two allies in Minas during the election campaign, following the first round which nominated a competing candidate to PL. The event will feature other pro-Bolsonaro politicians including Nikolas Ferreira and Domingos Sávio.

item.title: Flávio viaja ao Rio para debate depois de reunião com Tarcísio
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) traveled to Rio de Janeiro to participate in a debate organized by Globo after meeting with São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, with whom he defined strategies for the televised contest.

item.title: Secretário é afastado após defender prisão de eleitores do PT no MA
item.description: The municipal security secretary of Barra do Corda (MA), Sargento James Mota da Silva, was removed after audio recordings surfaced in which he advocates imprisoning PT supporters to intimidate voters. Mayor Rigo Teles (MDB) ordered his removal and the TSE-MA requested a federal police investigation into the statements threatening voting freedom.

item.title: Sem citar ‘Exército do Lula’, TSE diz que não determinou derrubada de canal de WhatsApp
item.description: The TSE stated it did not order the removal of any WhatsApp channels, including 'Exército do Lula', distancing itself from claims of pressure on Meta and other platforms. The court requested information from companies regarding the channel following a lawsuit filed by Flávio Bolsonaro's legal team, with a 24-hour deadline. A meeting was held with platform representatives to discuss measures until the second-round election.

item.title: Marçal não vai ao debate da Globo, mas vai ao Rio...
item.description: Pablo Marçal travels to Rio de Janeiro but skips the Globo debate, while Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign promotes the slogan 'Less Marçal and more Tarcísio'. The strategy aims to shift focus away from the PTB candidate toward the Rio governor.

item.title: “Flávio vai triturar o Brasil”, diz Lula
item.description: Lula claims Flávio Bolsonaro will 'trample Brazil' and threatens social gains with proposed R$250 billion budget cuts. The ad highlights areas like wages, pensions and social programs, while Flávio denies cutting social benefits.

item.title: Áudio: Eleitores voltam às urnas no domingo para definir o próximo presidente
item.description: The presidential election runoff will be decided between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), securing 47.03% and 45.16% of valid votes in the first round. The Electoral Court aims to reduce abstention, which reached 21.08% in the first phase.

item.title: Bap negociou com Flávio Bolsonaro sobre fim de bets em meio às semifinais do Flamengo na Libertadores
item.description: Flamengo president Luiz Eduardo Baptista (Bap) reportedly negotiated with PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to end the ban on sports betting (bets) in Brazil, during the Libertadores semifinals. Fans protested against the provisional measure maintaining the ban, and with the team eliminated, the club faces financial impacts for 2027.

item.title: “Na urna, você é o dono do seu destino”, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro released final campaign ads featuring supporters and the message 'on election day, you are the owner of your destiny'. Polling data shows him tied or leading in 15 of 17 national surveys.

item.title: TSE manda remover 26 posts com fake news contra Alfredo Gaspar
item.description: TSE auxiliary minister Estela Aranha ordered the removal of 26 social media posts accusing Alfredo Gaspar de Mendonça Neto, the running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), of rape. The preliminary injunction sets a three-hour deadline for the posts' removal.

item.title: TSE manda borrar foto de aliada de Flávio em propaganda de Lula
item.description: The TSE ordered Lula's campaign to air ads with Val Meliga's image blurred, following her right-of-response plea against being associated with criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling partially favored her, maintaining the blur by 6-1, while Minister Estela Aranha deemed the voluntary removal sufficient. Val Meliga, former PSL treasurer, argued that the broadcast harmed her honor by implying she belonged to the political group criticized by Lula.

item.title: Garotinho é impedido de votar no segundo turno após decisão do TRE-RJ
item.description: Former governor Anthony Garotinho had his candidacy rejected for the second round of the 2026 elections by the Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court following a decision by the Supreme Electoral Court, which upheld his ineligibility due to lack of full exercise of political rights. The suspension stems from a conviction for administrative misconduct in the Saúde em Movimento program, between 2005 and 2006. Garotinho stated he will appeal the decision.

item.title: Pode levar colinha nas eleições 2026? Veja o que diz o TSE e como organizar seus votos
item.description: Voters may use paper notes with candidate numbers at the polling station, as recommended by the TSE, but electronic devices such as cell phones are strictly prohibited. In the runoff, over 158 million Brazilians will vote for president and, in seven states, also for governor. Notes should be organized following the order displayed on the electronic ballot box.

item.title: ‘Flávio quer discutir grandes problemas do país’, diz Tarcísio de Freitas sobre debate
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas will be present at the presidential debate on Rede Globo and states that Flávio Bolsonaro is ready to tackle the country's major issues. Tarcísio has been increasing his influence in Flávio's campaign, helping refine his strategy to win undecided voters in the final stretch. After the debate, the governor plans to vote in São Paulo and travel to Brasília to follow the election results alongside Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: TSE nega ordem para retirar canais do WhatsApp e critica “ilações”
item.description: The TSE clarified that it did not order the removal of WhatsApp channels, dismissing 'inferences' about alleged determinations. The court met with representatives of digital platforms to discuss compliance with electoral legislation, following investigations into the 'Exército do Lula' channel, administered by André Janones. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign questioned coordinated support activities through the channel, which would have directed followers to perform specific Google searches.

item.title: Domingo é dia de votar: eleitores voltam às urnas para escolher presidente
item.description: In the 2026 presidential runoff, Brazilian voters choose between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for president. Voting takes place from 8am to 5pm, with adjusted times in certain regions, and is mandatory for voters aged 18 to 70. Some states also hold gubernatorial runoffs.

item.title: Brasileiros dominam primeira fase e são favoritos na Libertadores Feminina
item.description: Three Brazilian teams dominated the group stage of the 2026 Women's Libertadores, securing quarterfinal berths without suffering defeats. Corinthians and Cruzeiro finished with a 100% record, while Palmeiras claimed group leadership with seven points. The collective performance reinforces the strength of Brazilian women's football on the continent.

item.title: Após decisão de Mendonça, campanhas de Flávio e Lula entregam novos documentos e seguem sem abrir os sigilos
item.description: Following Minister André Mendonça's ruling, Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula submitted new documents to the TSE but did not release their data. Lula's team seeks TSE mediation to publish data simultaneously, while Flávio's camp agrees with the decision but has not opened its own records and asks Lula to disclose first.

item.title: Nunes Marques aguarda resposta da Meta sobre 'Exército do Lula' e indica que pode retirar canal do ar se houver irregularidade
item.description: The TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques, is awaiting Meta's response regarding the 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel to decide on its suspension. He ordered Meta, Google, and X to submit technical reports within 24 hours about alleged coordinated activity on social media. Suspension will depend on identifying electoral irregularities.
